representative_selection_rule: First normally completed correct attempt per task/runner; if absent, first correct partial attempt, explicitly labeled failed or timeout. All costs retain every attempt.
trace_metrics_note: Recomputed from archived per-request and CLI event logs. usage_complete and original CLI usage remain unchanged. observed_usage sums only terminal HTTP 200 records with valid nonnegative input/cache/output counts and no parse errors. Missing or invalid usage is never zero-filled. Archived request coverage includes records with unusable usage; it is not usage completeness. first_byte_ms_p50 is HTTP body TTFB, not first generated token latency. identical request hashes do not alone prove automatic retries.
